question:
A student wants to compare two thin prisms $P$ and $Q$ made of different materials. Both prisms have the **same refracting angle** $A=5^\circ$ and are used in air.

For prism $P$: $\mu_{y}=1.50$ and dispersive power $\omega_P=0.04$.
For prism $Q$: $\mu_{y}=1.60$ and dispersive power $\omega_Q=0.03$.

Using the relation $\omega=\dfrac{\mu_v-\mu_r}{\mu_y-1}$ and thin prism approximation, evaluate the claim:

**Claim:** "Prism $P$ will produce a greater angular dispersion between violet and red than prism $Q$."

options.A: True, because $\omega_P>\omega_Q$ always implies greater dispersion for the same prism angle.
options.B: False, because $\omega_P>\omega_Q$ but dispersion depends only on $\mu_y$.
options.C: False, because prism $Q$ produces greater angular dispersion since $(\mu_v-\mu_r)_Q>(\mu_v-\mu_r)_P$.
options.D: True, but only because $\mu_{y}$ of prism $P$ is smaller.
